name: Philosophies of Fortitude
description: Talent Level-Up Material.\nFortitude is the defining character of the frozen realm.\nIt breeds the prosperity of life itself. The people here have never bowed to the biting cold, just as a fragile seed defiantly chooses to bloom amidst the blizzards. This civilization has witnessed centuries of bitter winter, yet remains vibrant much like the Frostfairy Flower that flourishes season after season.
